//: Typechecks the shipped example plugins and connectors, which nothing else covered.
apps/api and packages/compiler each include only their own src/**, so everything
under examples/ was invisible to `bun run typecheck:*` — including plugin runtime
code the API imports at boot.
The 19 @ts-nocheck files in the compiler-side generators stay silent through their
directives; check:ts-nocheck keeps that count from growing.
Modules here reach across into apps/api and packages/compiler by relative path,
so the program is rooted at the repo root rather than at examples/.
allowImportingTsExtensions is for one of those reaches. packages/workflow-layout
is a bundler-resolution project whose own modules import each other with explicit
.ts extensions, so pulling any of them in from a NodeNext program raises TS5097 on
the package's INTERNAL imports — a file this project does not own and cannot fix
by writing its own specifiers differently. Nothing under examples/ uses a .ts
specifier; the flag only stops a dependency's from being an error here. Safe
because this project emits nothing, which is also what the flag requires.
